statement: The record orders a nitroglycerin infusion, but it also documents sildenafil 100 mg taken at 07:00, making nitroglycerin unsafe to start, so I will hold the infusion.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the ordered drug is contraindicated: "documents sildenafil 100 mg taken at 07:00, making nitroglycerin unsafe to start, so I will hold the infusion."
